releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.10 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.10**: every machine in the sidebar, and idle that tells you what's still running.

- **Machines in the sidebar.** Your sessions sit under this machine's name,
  which folds them away. Every other machine follows, folded; open one to see
  its sessions, and press one to move the window there and open it.
- **Background work.** A terminal that has gone quiet but still has something
  running behind it, such as a job sent off with `&` or an agent's background
  task, shows a hollow ring and the word "background" instead of a plain idle
  dot. Needs a phux server from 0.118.0 on.
- **Copy and paste on Omarchy.** Super+C and Super+V copy and paste, as in
  Omarchy's own terminals, instead of interrupting what's running. Rune now
  names its window `sh.phux.rune`; `phux omarchy setup` from the next phux release tags it a
  terminal. Ctrl+Insert and Shift+Insert copy and paste everywhere on Linux.
- **More keys reach the terminal.** Insert, Print Screen, Scroll Lock and
  Pause now go through to what runs there.

## [0.54.1](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/desktop-v0.54.0...desktop-v0.54.1) (2026-11-03)


### Bug Fixes

* **install:** reach a first agent in under 60s without brew trust ([#1879](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1879)) ([1da1f2e](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/1da1f2e3b05654086f46d2bcf2841dd1fd986d27))

Desktop: Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized.

macOS: download phux-desktop-0.54.1-macos-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Phux.app onto Applications. The ZIP is for automatic updates. Apple silicon macOS 26 or later; Ubuntu 24.04 GNU/Linux x64 and arm64 (X11 and Wayland; release qualification uses X11 with lavapipe). Recent DMGs include the phux CLI and server; older releases may require the separate CLI installer (https://phux.sh/install). Existing CLIs and running sessions are not replaced.

Windows x64: native desktop, WSL coordinator.

Install with the per-user PowerShell installer: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-phux/phux/main/scripts/install-desktop-windows.ps1 . The portable ZIP includes the same installer and the MSVC runtime. Requires an initialized WSL distribution with phux; signature verification requires minisign on Windows PATH or in WSL.

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.9 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.9**: a new look, every theme, and the desktop's newest moves.

- **The terminal is a card.** It sits inset with rounded corners on one quiet
  surface, in neutral colours that leave a terminal's own alone.
- **One title bar.** Session and terminal, tabs, updates and link targets share
  the band over the terminal; the status line is gone, so nothing costs a row,
  and the connection is only mentioned when it's in trouble.
- **A sidebar that reads.** A session of one terminal is one row, with what its
  agent is doing beneath the name. Splits dim the panes without the keyboard.
- **Twenty-six themes.** The GPUI desktop's whole set, dark then light, as
  tiles in Settings. **Change Theme** lists them and shows each one live as
  you move; Return keeps it, Escape puts the old one back.
- **Your Ghostty and Omarchy themes.** A Ghostty config on this machine
  becomes the **Ghostty** theme. On Omarchy, the **Omarchy** theme follows the
  current Omarchy theme and is the default until you pick another.
- **Insert Path.** ⌥; (or ⇧⌘I) opens a picker at the cursor that searches the
  pane's folder on the machine it runs on and types the pick as one shell word.
- **Switch Session.** ⇧⌘S finds a session by name, or makes one with the name
  you typed.
- **Typing.** What you type shows as typed, never underlined while the server
  confirms it.
- **Fixed:** choosing System after another theme now really goes back to the
  default colours.
